milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the coal ore cluster is already placed in the scene at approximately (-5, 1, -4) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=5 gives a comfortable approach radius for the multi-block cluster, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the coal.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the dark_oak_trapdoor is placed at (-4, -1, -5) relative to spawn on the floor near the coal deposit. max_distance=3 is tighter than the coal_ore milestone since the trapdoor is a single block the player must specifically locate on the floor. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking downward toward it.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted dark_oak_door ends up in the player's inventory and is not in the starting inventory. The recipe (6 dark_oak_planks in a 2x3 pattern) yields 3 doors, so min_count=1 is correct — any successful craft guarantees at least 1 door in inventory.
